vson_p:
# Event with three thematic roles: agent, patient, instrument.
# Demonstrates: punctual Event + role triadicity (the v0.1 dyadic-edge defect).

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 35mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (knight / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (qr / Quality :dimension Role :value knight))
   :depicts (boar / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Animal)
   :depicts (sword / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Weapon
               :hasQuality (qm / Quality :dimension Material :value steel))
   :occurs (strike / Event
              :lemma strike
              :agent knight
              :patient boar
              :instrument sword))
